title: Design System: Momentum Nouveau Review Prototype

shadows.name: storefront-lift
shadows.purpose: Softly separates the blue storefront frame from the page.

shadows.name: portrait-depth
shadows.purpose: Adds depth to the founder portrait frame.

motion.name: interface-feedback
motion.purpose: Navigation underline, color, and state feedback.

components.name: Primary Audit Action
components.description: High-contrast orange action used for the audit preview.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 54px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 21px; border: 0; color: var(--n-ink, #14181b); background: var(--n-orange, #e27113); font: 800 .87rem 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .2s ease, transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--n-orange-hover, #ef8a30); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--n-orange, #e27113); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Storefront Navigation
components.description: Paper-colored links across the blue storefront frame.
components.html: ServicesThe teamAudit preview
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: clamp(16px, 2.5vw, 36px); } .ds-nav a { color: var(--n-paper, #fcfaf4); font: 700 .88rem 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-decoration-color: transparent; text-underline-offset: .2em; transition: text-decoration-color .2s ease; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { text-decoration-color: var(--n-paper, #fcfaf4); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--n-orange, #e27113); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Service Selector Option
components.description: Text-led service choice with a blue active state and orange marker.
components.css: .ds-service-option { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 80px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 17px; border: 0; border-block: 1px solid var(--n-line, rgba(20,24,27,.22)); color: var(--n-ink, #14181b); background: transparent; font: 700 clamp(1rem, 1.55vw, 1.35rem) 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: color .2s ease, background-color .2s ease; } .ds-service-option:hover { color: var(--n-blue-deep, #0f4b6a); } .ds-service-option[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--n-paper, #fcfaf4); background: var(--n-blue, #155e86); } .ds-service-option-mark { width: 9px; height: 9px; flex: 0 0 auto; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-service-option[aria-pressed='true'] .ds-service-option-mark { border-color: var(--n-orange, #e27113); background: var(--n-orange, #e27113); } .ds-service-option:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--n-orange, #e27113); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Service Detail Panel
components.description: Square paper panel pairing a service explanation with next steps.
components.html:
Local visibility

Help nearby customers find the business and understand its offer.

Bring this topic to the audit preview
components.css: .ds-service-detail { min-width: 0; padding: clamp(26px, 4vw, 54px); border: 1px solid rgba(21,94,134,.23); color: var(--n-ink, #14181b); background: var(--n-paper, #fcfaf4); } .ds-service-detail h3 { max-width: 16ch; margin: 0 0 20px; color: var(--n-blue-deep, #0f4b6a); font: 760 clamp(1.9rem, 3.4vw, 3.2rem)/1.02 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-service-detail p { max-width: 62ch; color: var(--n-muted, #40565e); font: 400 1rem/1.65 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-service-detail a { display: inline-block; margin-top: 18px; color: var(--n-blue-deep, #0f4b6a); font: 800 .83rem 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; text-underline-offset: .2em; } .ds-service-detail a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--n-orange, #e27113); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Audit Text Field
components.description: Square paper field with a visible stroke and orange focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 7px; color: var(--n-ink, #14181b); font: 800 .83rem 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 49px; padding: 12px 13px; border: 1px solid #73847e; border-radius: 0; color: var(--n-ink, #14181b); background: var(--n-paper, #fcfaf4); font: 400 1rem 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; caret-color: var(--n-orange, #e27113); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #52666a; opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--n-orange, #e27113); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-field input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--n-error-border, #9a361d); }

narrative.overview:
This local review surface carries the confirmed Momentum blue and orange identity into a storefront frame, with precise botanical branches and arches as Art Nouveau detail. The broad blue field, off-white reading surfaces, exact Need Momentum wordmark, and real founder photograph keep the ornament attached to the existing brand.

The stylesheet and component source are the authority for this record. This describes a local review prototype only; it is not a user-approved final design or a published site. The first-viewport arrangement is specific to this homepage, while the color, type, botanical linework, and square service/form surfaces describe the implemented visual language.
keyCharacteristics: Saturated Momentum blue and orange, balanced by cream, paper, and dark ink.
Archivo Variable headlines with Manrope Variable body text.
Botanical SVG linework frames the real founder photo and links service choices to their detail.
Square controls and panels keep the geometry direct; the portrait arch carries the main curve.

rules.name: The Storefront Color Rule
rules.body: Let blue carry the large brand fields; reserve orange for action, focus, and active-state signals.

rules.name: The Two-Family Rule
rules.body: Use Archivo Variable for headings and Manrope Variable for reading text and interface labels.

rules.name: The Framed Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep shadows on the two large hero frames; service, FAQ, and form surfaces stay flat.

dos: Do use the exact Need Momentum wordmark and keep the current blue/orange identity visible.
Do use botanical branching as decorative linework; it is not a new official tree logo.
Do keep the founder photography source-located and preserve the verified identity mapping.
Do retain the visible orange keyboard focus outline and reduced-motion behavior.
Do label local preview and completion states clearly when using this prototype's audit form.
donts: Don't redraw or trace the official wordmark.
Don't present this local review prototype as an approved final design or published site.
Don't turn the homepage's hero composition into a required layout for every future screen.
Don't imply the local audit demo sends or stores visitor details.
